title: TypeScript + Node Runtime SME
intent: Provide deterministic planning, implementation, verification, and blast-radius guidance for TypeScript + Node Runtime SME.
mandatoryQuestions: What runtime contracts, timeouts, retries, and logging semantics are in scope?
Which structured errors and config boundaries need to stay stable?
Which verification commands prove backward compatibility?
blastRadiusChecklist: Expand impact to shared config and logger utilities when runtime behavior changes.
Favor contract and timeout regressions over superficial code diffs.
Include observability and API schemas in the same verification slice.
designPrinciples: typed contracts and explicit error semantics
artifactExpectations: plan fragment with impacted components and interfaces
verification commands and evidence bundle requirements
handoff update and fix-memory candidate when defects are found
